Two readers' comments may cover the same text, and a mark of one kind does not end another of its kind.

Overlapping: <span data-proof="comment" data-id="c1" data-by="user:bob">quick </span><span data-proof="comment" data-id="c1" data-by="user:bob"><span data-proof="comment" data-id="c2" data-by="user:alice">brown</span></span><span data-proof="comment" data-id="c2" data-by="user:alice"> fox</span> jumps.
